name: Banking Blocks for WooCommerce
author: LokusWP

sections.description:
Expand your payment acceptance with custom payment methods for local banks that support WooCommerce Checkout Blocks. This plugin makes it easy to add and configure multiple local bank transfer options for your online store.

Key Features:
– 2 Local Bank Transfers Customizable that support WooCommerce Checkout Blocks
– Indonesian Banking (BCA, BSI, BRI, BNI, MANDIRI) & Payment Method (QRIS, DANA)
– Easy Setup: Simple configuration for bank accounts
– Automatically display payment information in Thankyou Page
– Automatically display payment information in Emails Notification

Perfect For:
– Local businesses accepting bank transfers
– WooCommerce shops needing local payment options

sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Payments
  3. Enable and configure your local bank accounts
  4. Add your payment instructions
  5. Start accepting local payments!
